generation.scope: A finite-Frobenius point graph window with three coherently commuting letters is automatically Koszul and AS regular and free on both sides over their polynomial algebra. Any graph of maximal degree seven is a pure genus-five curve. In the smooth integral case it is exactly the alternating kernel window of two canonical projections at an ordered pair differing by exact four-torsion. Finite Frobenius and graph tests suffice, with isomorphism by curve isomorphisms of the ordered pair and period one exactly when the two points can be exchanged. Nonemptiness of its parameter locus is not asserted.

open_mathematics: Resolve the smooth septic finite rank conditions by expressing the canonical net in the common three letters and the two distinguished projections; test whether the surviving parameters give bielliptic curves or are empty. Extend the elliptic test to singular and reducible quartics.
